nodes.text: I didn't want to take the Covid vaccine,so I was forced to take it . My parents forced me to take it . I knew it was a poison . I regret it , now this new virus HMPV is out , I will not take any vaccine. I won't listen to my parents who believe in the media .

nodes.text: I pray to God to remove every single particle of the Covid vaccine out of my body and I believe he will answer my prayers.
